svg.title: Scherkenoid: a connected reflection model
svg.desc: Original schematic based on Hoffman, Martin and White, Figures 5 and 11. A central sheet opens into alternating wings. Alpha equals pi over two and width equals pi. The drawing uses the upward translation convention and is not an exact or numerically solved translator.

g.text: α = π/2 · w = π · upward translation
Two periods of a schematic reflection model.
Not a solved translator. All outer edges are display cuts.
